note: Landscape table printed sideways on a portrait page. Surya emitted all 84 cells in scrambled order, with misreads including 'aung' for Sun and Cyrillic 'Мооп' for Moon. Transcribed by eye from img/bj/s021a.png rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise.

### Table showing Mutual Friendship etc of Planets

| Planets | Sun | Moon | Mars | Mercury | Jupiter | Venus | Saturn | Rahu | Ketu |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Whom it considers as friend | Jupiter, Mars, Moon | Sun, Mercury | Moon, Jupiter, Sun | Rahu, Venus, Sun | Sun, Mars, Moon | Mercury, Saturn, Rahu | Venus, Mercury, Rahu | Venus, Mercury, Saturn | Venus, Mercury, Saturn |
| Whom it considers as enemy | Saturn, Rahu, Venus | Rahu, Ketu | Mercury, Rahu | Moon | Mercury, Venus | Sun, Moon | Sun, Mars, Moon | Sun, Mars, Moon | Sun, Mars, Moon |
| Whom it considers as neutral | Mercury | Saturn, Venus, Jupiter, Mars | Saturn, Venus | Jupiter, Mars, Saturn | Rahu, Saturn | Jupiter, Mars | Jupiter | Jupiter | Jupiter |
